name: Chosun Ilbo TikTok Clips
summary: Turn a long Chosun Ilbo YouTube episode into editable vertical TikTok Drafts in the program's own format, with headlines and captions.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI, Project importFiles and startAnalysis, Draft setFrameSize, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic, and the panel file service. Checked on Selects 2.0.580 on macOS. Declares @speaker-profiling off, so Selects builds that read it open the analysis credit dialog with speaker profiling off; older builds ignore the line and profile speakers.
